answers.rationale: The Southwest nonstop is the only simple itinerary that gets Maya to Milwaukee with usable Wednesday-afternoon margin and ample time for the 6:00 p.m. host dinner. The $18 premium over Delta is small relative to avoiding a post-dinner arrival; the open-seating drawback is limited for a solo work trip. The cheaper American option adds connections, including a tight 45-minute return connection.

Assumes Southwest open seating is acceptable for this solo trip.

unsupported_assumptions: Assumes the outbound DFW connection is a normal, legal connection with no unusual operational risk beyond the stated itinerary.
Assumes Maya values avoiding the very early outbound and late return more than the small fare savings of the Southwest nonstop.
